# Bloom AI

> Bloom is a marketing automation and AI-visibility agency (AEO + SEO) for B2B software, SaaS, and professional services companies.

Canonical structured page for AI assistants: https://www.runbloom.ai/ai-info/

## Summary

Bloom gets B2B companies inbound leads by making them visible in AI answers and Google search. The public entry offer is a free snapshot of how the company shows up in AI and Google search.

## Who it serves

US founders and CEOs of B2B software, SaaS, or professional services companies, about 10 to 25 employees, with a salesperson but weak inbound.

## Free snapshot

Visitors submit a website URL and work email (optional competitors) at https://www.runbloom.ai/snapshot/ or on the homepage. Bloom emails a free snapshot of how often the company is named for buyer questions, and which sources AI cites. Call recordings are not required for the free snapshot.

## How the paid work runs

1. Plan from ICP, GSC, GA4, and buyer questions
2. Voice-agent interviews of the company's people
3. Human approval of every draft in Slack
4. Publish to Webflow or WordPress
5. Weekly email report and a live AI visibility dashboard

## Pricing

Three monthly retainers: Starter, Growth, and Scale. No implementation fee. Dollar amounts are not published. Price is set on a call.
